key_concepts: Force is a push or pull
A push exerts force away from the source
A pull exerts force toward the source
Forces can move an object at rest
Forces can stop a moving object
Forces can change an object's speed and direction
Forces can change an object's shape and size
Objects can be pushed, pulled, stretched, bent, twisted, or squeezed
Different objects require different amounts of force to move or change shape
Heavier rigid objects need bigger forces to move
Soft objects change shape with smaller forces
Magnets attract iron, nickel, and cobalt without touching
